# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 22 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Jacob's Blessing; The Years of Plenty End

---

**1** Jacob lived with Joseph in Egypt for seventeen years. He lived to see the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh, and also Machir the son of Manasseh — whose children Jacob held on his knees.

**2** The years of famine came to an end, and the land produced its fruit abundantly.

**3** Around that time Jacob became ill. His sons gathered around him, along with all the leaders and rulers of Egypt. Jacob blessed his sons.

**4** Jacob lived to be one hundred and forty-seven years old.

**5** After Jacob died, Joseph and Aseneth and their whole household went to Heliopolis to mourn for him.

**6** All Egypt mourned for Jacob for seven days.

**7** When the mourning period ended, Joseph and his brothers each returned to their own place.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
